source_title: Envision Achieves World's First Commercial Deployment of Integrated 800V DC SST-Based Power System in Large-Scale AI Data Center
claim: Envision publicly reports that an integrated SST-based 800VDC system is deployed at its named Galaxy AI Data Center and powers live AI computing workloads.
evidence_summary: Named-site operator statement for Galaxy AI Data Center in Ulanqab; 10kV AC / SST / 800VDC architecture and live AI computing load are operator-reported. Independent acceptance, measured load, protection results, operating duration and economics remain unknown.
counter_evidence: The August 2026 campus opening, planned 3GW capacity and accelerator ambition do not establish SST/800VDC commissioning timing or actual commissioned load.
reason: Admit a traceable public operator statement without promoting it to independent technical-performance proof.
